sources.snippet: The video shows UniX AI's Panther (wheeled dual-arm humanoid, mislabeled as "Unipath" in the post). Real capabilities (per company demos + real Suzhou home deployments): wakes users, operates appliances (stove, blender, washer), cooks basic meals (stir-fry), serves food, tidies/organizes, sweeps, cleans sinks/toilets, does laundry.
